# KnowMe / 灵犀 — Full public context

- Brand: 灵犀 / KnowMe

- Core proposition: 把 AI，变成你的能力。 / Turn AI into your capability.
- Product principles: Agent First. Local First. Human Always.

## What KnowMe is
KnowMe explores an Agent-First, Local-First Personal AI and personal knowledge operating system. The goal is to connect voice capture, long-term memory, knowledge graphs, agents, calendars, tasks, health context and multi-device collaboration into one continuously growing personal intelligence workspace.

It does not start from “adding a chat box to an app.” The intended interaction model starts from goals and context: an agent organizes relevant knowledge, memory, tools and actions, while important judgment, confirmation and authorization remain with the human.

## Why it exists
Most AI interactions still reset too much context. Personal knowledge is fragmented across files, notes, calendars, tasks, devices and specialized apps. KnowMe explores whether a personal AI can:
1. move from temporary answers to long-term collaboration;
2. turn a personal knowledge base from storage into an action system;
3. connect memory, tools, schedules, health context and real tasks;
4. keep important personal data under user control through Local-First design;
5. convert accumulated experience into reusable, augmentable capability.

## Current public exploration areas
- Huawei Mate60 / Android native client direction
- Offline Chinese voice capture and transcription
- Personal long-term memory and knowledge growth
- Agent-native workflows
- 2D / 3D knowledge and cognitive graphs
- Calendar, todo and project action loops
- Local-first data boundaries
- Replaceable model and Agent Harness
- Health context and plugin expansion
- Multi-device collaboration direction

## Six showcase scenes
1. Neural Perception / 神经感知 — lower the friction of voice and information capture.
2. Intelligent Agent Dialogue / 智能对话 — collaborate with an agent inside knowledge context.
3. 2D Knowledge Graph / 2D 知识图谱 — connect topics, records, sources and cognitive dimensions.
4. 3D Cognitive Galaxy / 3D 认知星海 — explore a spatial representation of a growing knowledge network.
5. Calendar & Tasks / 日程与任务 — move knowledge into plans, schedules and action.
6. Health Context / 健康上下文 — explore source-backed health context, rhythms and plans without claiming diagnostic authority.

## Product status boundary
Public website visibility does NOT mean formal product release.

These are separate states:
- public page or demo;
- code exists;
- engineering candidate;
- Product Experience PASS;
- Human Owner Acceptance;
- formal Release.

Some public visuals use synthetic demonstration data. Product capability should not be inferred from a demo unless the corresponding repository state and evidence support it.

## Long-term direction
Super Individual → Super Team → Super Organization.

The team and organization directions are long-term product vision. They are not claims that team or organization products have already been released.
